For each escalation in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an agent would post when escalating: why it's being escalated and to whom, based only on the fields given. Do not invent facts beyond what's given. Vary tone/length.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"escalations": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.
